Timer Talisman

An exam and study timer. Choose a timer, set it up, and open it in a new tab for the board or projector. The preview on the right is the real thing, so you can try it before you open it.

Timer type

Layout

Settings this layout does not show are hidden below. Change the layout to see them again.

Settings

Fill in from the exam timetable

Fills in the date, the start (10 minutes of reading before the writing starts) and every subject writing in that venue. Subjects with the same writing time share a column. Check it against the latest timetable: venues can change.
Subject 2
Subject 3
Up to three subjects. They share the start and the reading time; each has its own writing time, and its own column with the time left and finish time.

The built-in recording is the Grade 8–11 exam regulations. The timer shows a big play button until the exam starts, and a small one in its controls after that. A recording you choose yourself stays in this browser and is not part of the link; on another computer, choose it again in the timer's settings, or that computer uses the built-in one.

Display

The picture stays in this browser and is not part of the link. On another computer, choose it again in the timer's settings.

For example your school's colours. Saved in this browser.
Font
Fonts under "More fonts" load from Google Fonts when you pick one.
Live preview
Link copied

In the timer: Space start or pause, R reset, F full screen, + − add or take off a minute, L lap. The controls hide while the timer runs; move the mouse to bring them back.

The link holds all your settings, so you can open it on another computer, such as the one connected to the projector. Your settings here are remembered in this browser.
